verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents documents deploying agents and arbitrary code as realtime room participants on LiveKit Cloud, and placing outbound calls. Nothing in the pack describes user-configurable automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled, recurring or event-triggered jobs outside a live session. Deployment hosting and one-off outbound calls are adjacent features, not a background-automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
